task_message:
Case V18: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 121x121x94 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is finished. Final summary:

- **Target**: vascular soft-tissue tumor in the anterior compartment of the limb, best seen on the T2-weighted axial/coronal/sagittal series as a mildly hyperintense, spindle-shaped mass tapering to the skin at its superior and inferior ends.
- **Method**: located the lesion with axial/coronal/sagittal sheets, seeded nnInteractive with a positive point inside the superficial part of the mass, then used a second point to trim the adjacent markedly hyperintense superficial structure (interpreted as a skin fiducial marker, not tumor).
- **Result**: single connected component, 6.9 mL, extent axial 30–74, coronal 77–102, sagittal 43–61; outline checked in all three planes and shown to taper cleanly at both ends in the final review. Automatic intensity-based candidates (fat/fascia) were rejected.
- **Confidence**: medium (boundary is clean in all three planes, but lesion identity carries some residual uncertainty given the bright superficial structure).
